description: Consumer Airfare Report: Table 7 - Fare Premiums for Select Cities with More Than 20 Passengers per Day is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Aviation", published or maintained by Department of Transportation Office of the Assistant Secretary for Aviation and International Affairs. Provides fare premiums for airports in the top 1,000 city pairs, and demonstrates the impact of low-fare service and hub domination on fare levels. All records are aggregated as directionless city pair markets. Air traffic in each direction is combined. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Aviation". It has 24 columns, among them SHMkts, quarter, TotalMkts, tbl, SHPax, SHPerPrem. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last data update. Attribution given: Department of Transportation Office of the Assistant Secretary for Aviation and International Affairs. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
